authoritative_freeze.event: first git commit containing this artifact
authoritative_freeze.resolution: Resolve the immutable commit from git history after the commit; do not rewrite this protocol after numerical access.

source.title: OEDI: Dataset for H2SAFE - Controlled Gas Releases and Sensor-Response for Indoor Hydrogen Safety
metadata_seen_before_freeze: Search-result title and public landing URL
Description that the archive includes time-series gas concentrations, sensor coordinates, release-source coordinates, geometry and HVAC documentation
Description that multiple nozzle sizes, orientations, pressures and flow rates are represented

required_fields: publisher-authenticated sensor coordinates in the same Cartesian frame
declared elevation axis and coordinate units
release start and stop or publisher-authenticated time crosswalk
source provenance, file digest and reuse terms
excluded_cases: hydrogen blends without a separable hydrogen response
cases missing source coordinates, sensor coordinates or numerical sensor response
eligibility.case_selection: Include every case in the publisher-authenticated archive that satisfies the frozen requirements; do not exclude a case after viewing response metrics.
eligibility.overlap_rule: Hash and identity-check cases against the HyTunnel-CS, legacy H2SAFE and USN open-channel development cohorts before scoring. Any overlap is ineligible.
eligibility.ineligible_effect: Record the exact failed fields and do not execute the candidate.

response.definition: q99 minus q10 hydrogen concentration during the publisher-authenticated release/evaluation interval
response.sensor_pool: all eligible numerical hydrogen-concentration sensors in the common coordinate frame
response.missing_value_policy: No imputation of a sensor response or coordinate; report the case as ineligible.
response.format_amendment_policy: A format-only amendment may repair parsing or axis naming but may not change case scope, candidate, response definition or thresholds.

decision_rule.failure_effect: Retain the negative holdout and keep runtime spatial routing disabled.
decision_rule.pass_effect: Support only cross-facility sensor-rank transfer in the tested indoor domain; runtime use still requires an explicit safety review.

claim_boundary: A passing result would support only the frozen rank heuristic across the eligible OEDI indoor actual-hydrogen cases. It would not validate concentration magnitude, alarm time, detector coverage completeness, CFD, ESD effectiveness, outdoor HRS dispersion, consequence distance or field safety.
